prose: WP03 provisions the per-env KMS CMK + Secrets Manager entries + scoped IAM roles (External Secrets, ADOT, ALB Controller, GitHub Actions) + EKS Pod Identity associations + GitHub Actions OIDC provider. WP03 also adds two additive Helm chart templates (externalsecret.yaml + serviceaccount.yaml) + updates values.yaml + extends the values.schema.json to allow the post-WP03 default (ExternalSecrets-only path, no inline secrets). The CI workflow is extended with helm lint + helm template + secret-scan steps. The 6 tofu test runs assert prevent_destroy on secrets, CMK deletion_window + key rotation, scoped IAM policies (with documented AWS-mandated exceptions: XRayWrites, EC2ReadOnly, ELBv2Scoped, ECRGetAuthToken), secrets encrypted with the per-env CMK, secret versions exist, and pod identity associations target the correct namespaces. prevent_destroy is a meta-block not directly queryable in tofu test -- asserted by code review. The Karpenter controller role is owned by the cluster module (S2 per the plan) and exposed as karpenter_iam_role_arn; the cluster module self-references its own output for that input.

files_created.description: Identity module provider pinning: OpenTofu >=1.6.0, aws >=5.40.0.
Identity module inputs: env, eks_cluster_name, eks_oidc_provider_arn, openai_api_key (sensitive), chroma_auth_token (sensitive, default null), domain_suffix.

Per-env KMS CMK + alias; OpenAI + Chroma secrets + versions (Chroma conditional on chroma_auth_token != null); 4 scoped IAM roles (External Secrets, ADOT, ALB Controller, GitHub Actions) with documented AWS-mandated Resource=* exceptions; 3 EKS Pod Identity associations; GitHub Actions OIDC provider. M1/M5/M8 misfits addressed.
Identity module outputs: cmk_arn, cmk_alias, openai_secret_arn, chroma_auth_secret_arn, 4 role ARNs (external_secrets, adot, alb_controller, github_actions), github_oidc_provider_arn.

6 tofu test runs asserting: prevent_destroy on secrets (via name check), CMK deletion_window + key_rotation, IAM policies scoped (with documented exceptions), secrets encrypted with CMK (via name check), secret versions exist, pod identity associations target correct namespaces.
Additive Helm template (WP03): ClusterSecretStore + per-secret ExternalSecret resources. Secret data flows: AWS Secrets Manager -> ESO -> Kubernetes Secret -> env var. Auth via EKS Pod Identity.
Additive Helm template (WP03): ServiceAccount with EKS Pod Identity association annotation. The annotation is filled at tofu apply time via a helm_release override.
Modified to gate on .Values.useLegacySecretInlining (legacy inlined-secret path); the post-WP03 default is false, so this template renders an empty manifest under default values.

Added env (default 'dev'), externalSecrets block (enabled, region, refreshInterval, secrets list), serviceAccounts block (enabled, entries for external-secrets/adot-collector/aws-load-balancer-controller), useLegacySecretInlining toggle (default false), and changed secret.* defaults to null.
Updated schema to allow useLegacySecretInlining toggle; when false (post-WP03 default), secret.openaiApiKey is no longer required (the ExternalSecrets path supplies it).

Added helm lint + helm template + secret-scan steps (T015). The secret scan greps rendered chart output for sk-<base62>, OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-*, and CHROMA_AUTH_TOKEN=<value> patterns -- all must return 0 matches.
Root config extended to call modules/identity; cluster module's cmk_arn now reads from module.identity.cmk_arn and karpenter_iam_role_arn from module.cluster.karpenter_iam_role_arn (self-ref).
Removed placeholder cmk_arn and karpenter_iam_role_arn variables (now sourced from modules).

Added karpenter_iam_role_arn output (currently points at the MNG node role; a dedicated Karpenter controller role + PodIdentityAssociation is deferred to a follow-up that depends on the chart's ServiceAccount annotation wiring).
Removed placeholder cmk_arn and karpenter_iam_role_arn lines (now sourced from modules); added domain_suffix = 'support-bot.example.com'.
